skills.name: Charisma B

noblePhantasm.name: Excalibur: Sword of Promised Victory
noblePhantasm.chant: Gathered breath of the planet, torrential light of life... EX---CALIBUR!
noblePhantasm.description: Deals devastating holy burst damage to all foes and recharges 20% NP gauge.

lore: The legendary King of Britain who pulled Caliburn from the stone.
summonQuote: Servant Saber. I ask of you, are you my Master?
battleStartQuote: My blade is drawn. For chivalry and the holy vow!
victoryQuote: Victory is decided. Let our honor remain untarnished.
defeatQuote: Forgive me, Master... I have failed to protect Britain...

name: Gilgamesh
title: King of Heroes

skills.name: Collector EX
skills.description: Increases Critical Star absorption by 600% and charges 30% NP.

skills.name: Golden Rule A
skills.description: Increases NP generation rate by 50% for 3 turns.

skills.name: Treasury of Babylon
skills.description: Gains 20 Critical Stars and increases Critical Damage by 40%.

noblePhantasm.name: Enuma Elish: Star of Creation
noblePhantasm.chant: I speak of the beginning... Heaven and Earth split! ENUMA ELISH!
noblePhantasm.description: Unleashes the primordial spatial rupture of Ea.

lore: The oldest hero in human mythology and sovereign of Uruk.
summonQuote: Fuhahaha! You have managed to summon me, mongrel. Rejoice.
battleStartQuote: Know your place before the King of Heroes!
victoryQuote: A foregone conclusion. Even a worm could not stand before Ea.
defeatQuote: Im-impossible... A mere mongrel defeated the King...?!

title: Black King of Knights

skills.name: Mana Burst A

skills.name: Charisma E
skills.description: Increases party attack power by 12% for 3 turns.

noblePhantasm.name: Excalibur Morgan: Sword of Promised Victory
noblePhantasm.chant: Take this... The cry of a dying star! Let the dark breath of the dragon consume all! EX---CALIBUR... MORGAN!
noblePhantasm.description: Unleashes a catastrophic wave of black light, dealing massive damage to all enemies and recharging NP gauge.

lore: The Black King of Knights, Artoria Pendragon dyed in black by the mud of the Holy Grail. A cold, merciless tyrant who fights with relentless power, wielding the corrupted Excalibur Morgan.
summonQuote: Servant Saber, Artoria Alter. I have materialized in response to your summons. Master, are you prepared to govern with an iron fist?
battleStartQuote: There is no mercy on this battlefield. Disappear.
victoryQuote: A predictable outcome. Clean up the residue.

name: Nero Claudius
title: Emperor of Roses

skills.name: Migraine B
skills.description: Relieves headache through imperial willpower, charging own NP gauge by 20% and gaining focus.
Acquires supreme skills via royal prerogative. Recovers 4,200 HP and boosts combat power by 25% for 3 turns.

skills.name: Thrice Setting Sun A
skills.description: Invictus Spiritus. Grants absolute fortitude, increasing Defense by 100% for 1 turn and boosting survivability.

noblePhantasm.name: Laus Saint Claudius: Imperium of the Maiden's Blooming
noblePhantasm.chant: Behold my talent, listen to the thunderous applause! Let the golden theater open! Laus Saint Claudius!
noblePhantasm.description: Deploys the Golden Theater Aestus Domus Aurea, raining blazing crimson rose strikes that ignore defense and shred enemy armor.
noblePhantasm.overchargeEffect: Reduces all enemies' DEF by 20% for 3 turns + 20% NP refund

lore: The Fifth Emperor of the Roman Empire, sovereign of the Golden Theater, and self-proclaimed supreme artist. Wielding her beloved crimson meteor blade Aestus Estus, she commands the battlefield with boundless passion.
summonQuote: Umu! Servant Saber, Nero Claudius has answered your summons! Rejoice, Master, for the greatest artist of Rome is now at your side!
battleStartQuote: The curtains rise on our glorious stage! Behold my supreme performance!
victoryQuote: A splendid triumph! Raise the roses high and let the applause echo throughout the empire! Umu!
defeatQuote: The spotlight dims... But the glory of Rome shall never fade...
